notes: New Options tab in Settings, sitting just under Panels. It is the home for the things a panel can show that are not your machine's own readings.
Weather has moved into it, out of General. Nothing about weather changed — same location, same units, same icons, same place to set them, just an easier one to find.

The tab is built to grow: shortcuts, video and other item links are meant to live here next to weather, and each will appear as its own section as it is built. Nothing is shown until it actually works.
